description: Publish 1 to 5 apps in ONE call, each at its own stable URL, all managed by ONE system token (ADR-0352). No account needed. Each app is a self-contained HTML file and goes through the same safety scan as dropyour_publish; an app that is refused does not block the others, and the answer names it with the reason. KEEP systemToken: it is shown once, and it manages every app of this system (pass it as managementToken to replace, configure or delete any of them), and nothing else. These apps are NOT linked to each other: you, the agent, use them together. Linking apps under a contract (dropyour_link) needs an account and graduated apps. Your tier: anonymous — max 5 MB per app, default expiration 30 days.

html.description: The complete self-contained HTML of this app (inline CSS/JS, max 5 MB)

key.description: A short unique key for this app inside the system, lowercase (e.g. "crm", "quotes").

name.description: A private name for this app. Default: its HTML <title>.

expiresInSeconds.description: Expiration for every app, in seconds (default: your tier's, 30 days).

name.description: A private name for the system (only you see it).

name: dropyour_publish_system
title: Publish a system of apps
